info:
Triggers the error log fetch every 5 seconds.
Ensures the dashboard table stays up to date
with the latest errors from global context.

name: Get error log
info:
Fetches the last 10 errors from global context
(error_log) and formats them for display in
the dashboard table.

Returns errors in reverse chronological order
(newest first) with the following fields:
- time: timestamp (formatted)
- type: error type in uppercase
- source: source node name
- status: HTTP status code or 'none'
- message: error message (max 60 chars)

label: Last error
info:
Displays the last 10 errors from the error log
in a table on the Error Monitor dashboard page.

Updates every 5 seconds via the timestamp
inject node. Table is replaced (not appended)
on each update.

Columns (auto-calculated):
- time, type, source, status, message

name: Build GET /tags request
info:
Builds a GET request to fetch all tags from Rayvn API.
Sets Authorization header using API key from rayvn_config.

name: Set label globals
info:
Finds WaSOS and Parat-Bridge labels from GET /tags response
and stores them as global variables for use across flows.
